newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra bill incomplete in Australian Senate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra bill incomplete in Australian Senate.

text.p: The Australian Senate adjourned on Monday without completing the bill to sell a third of publicly owned telecoms carrier Telstra Corp, despite government hopes that the proposed legislation would be finalised.
The bill, which would authorise Australia's biggest ever privatisation, will now be debated again on Tuesday.
The Liberal-National government, which is two senators short of a majority in the upper house, is expected to win the final vote with the backing of two independents.
On Thursday the government announced several measures that answered concerns that the independents had expressed about backing the bill.
However, neither of the independents has publicly said he will vote for the bill.
The government expects the sale to raise about A$8 billion.
